title: Secret Reference
description: A reference to a secret held in a provider (Vault, External Secrets Operator, cloud secret manager) — NEVER the secret value. Manifests and services point at secrets by provider+path+key so the value is resolved at runtime and never serialized into config, code or the registry. The schema forbids an inline 'value' field to enforce reference-not-value.

name.description: Logical secret name used by the consumer.

key.description: Field within the secret at that path.

version.description: Optional pinned version; omit for latest.

dynamic.description: True for short-lived/dynamic secrets (e.g. Vault DB creds).
